Name: Fish Tank Wallpaper
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[u][b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b][/u]

Drop wallpaper into fish tanks just as you would any other item. The back glass pane of the tank will be replaced with the wallpaper..

Fish tank wallpaper is displayed the same size as ordinary wallpaper, which means it usually doesn't show the entire height of the wallpaper sprite. 

To adjust the portion of the wallpaper displayed, hover over the tank and hold down the up or down adjust keys (default [b]Up[/b] and [b]Down[/b] keys).

Also check out [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55970]Fish Tank Capacity[/url][/b] for adding custom decorations to fish tanks.

[u][b][size=5]Custom Fish Tanks[/size][/b][/u]

In order for fish tanks to display wallpaper, they must be added to this mod's dictionary using content patcher, e.g.:

[code]{
    "Format": "2.9.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.FishTankWallpaper/dict",
            "Entries": {
                "MyFishTank": [
                    {
                        "Texture": "PathToTextureWithoutBackGlass",
                        "WallpaperBounds": {
                            "X": 4,
                            "Y": 10,
                            "Width": 104,
                            "Height": 19
                        }
                    }
                ]
            }
        }
    ]
}[/code]
The texture should be a duplicate of the fish tank's main texture with the back pane of glass removed. You can see how this is done in the mod's assets/fishtanks.png file.

The bounds refers to the portion of the sprite that should contain the wallpaper.


[u][b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b][/u]

Requires SMAPI.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Translations should use config variable names as the keys, adding .Desc to the end of the key for hover descriptions.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
